note: b_heart (awake): a free recolour of the chosen dormant Heart (art/raw/h/b_heart_dormant.png, H frame 1), made in pixelart_workbench (image f2db78aa; change list in art/edit/h/b_heart.workbench.json) and recorded here in scripts/art/recolor.ts form so it replays offline: 'node scripts/art/recolor.ts art/edit/h/edits.json' rebuilds art/edit/h/b_heart.png pixel for pixel (checked against the workbench download). The four glass colours #172038 #253a5e #3c5e8b #1e1d39 occur only in the core gem and the four corner conduits (checked: none in the stone), so plain colour maps touch nothing else. The stone, moss and outlines are untouched, so it is the same machine.
